data.description: When you talk about Dubai, it is synonymous with Jumeirah. It is one of the most coveted places to live in this city of wonders. It is home to a varied range of housing options, with the sea right beside and a lively vibe all across the area.

about.data:
Introducing the exquisite The Alba Furnished Residences, a glamorous addition to the iconic Palm Jumeirah in Dubai, developed by the esteemed OMNIYAT. This project includes luxury serviced apartments and an elegant hotel designed by the renowned Zaha Hadid Architects with the prestigious management of the Dorchester Collection. 

The Alba Furnished Residences offers a selection of residences, featuring a diverse mix of 2 to 3-bedroom options with generous floor plans ranging from 1,800 to 2,850 sq. ft. This remarkable mixed-use development encapsulates modern elegance, ensuring that each living space caters to the refined tastes of its discerning clientele, while also providing flexible living arrangements for various lifestyles.

Residents can indulge in a wealth of luxurious amenities, including expansive terraces that invite the tranquility of the outdoors, along with access to a state-of-the-art wellness facility designed for relaxation and rejuvenation.

A project by Dorchester Collection and managed by Omniyat, Ela Residences is perfectly positioned on the iconic Palm Jumeirah. It is the last property on the island, offering buyers an opportunity to be part of a secret piece of haven on an instantly recognisable symbol of luxury.

You can choose from 3 super penthouses, and 3- and 4-bedroom simplex and duplex units in Ela Dorchester Collection. Famous architect Zaha Hadid has designed this exclusive residential enclave, while the landscaping is done by Vladimir Djurovic. Amenities in Palm Ela Residences include seamless indoor-outdoor living spaces, private pools in each residence, and elevated sun lounging platforms.

An icon created especially for you in Palm Jumeirah. A modern designer superstructure offers you 3-4 Bedroom Penthouses, 5 Bedroom Sky Villas, and 6 Bedroom Sky Mansions. Redefining luxury, comfort, craftsmanship, and an unmatched lifestyle. One Crescent has 25 luxury villas & penthouses in the sky.

They have panoramic ocean views, the Burj Al Arab, the Dubai cityscape, terraces with private swimming pools, and expansive entertainment rooms. The overall design utilizes a basic material palette to reflect the unique style and oozes luxury living via its significant presence in the city.

data.answer: A mesmerising waterfront community, Jumeirah has been rated as the second-best villa destination in Dubai. The entire area is divided into smaller communities named as, City Walk, Jumeirah 1, Jumeirah 2, Jumeirah 3, & Jumeirah Bay Islands. Come home to Jumeirah’s lively, exciting lifestyle with only the most high-end experiences. Properties for sale in Jumeirah, as well as properties for rent in Jumeirah, offer you varied styles.

In Jumeirah, you can choose from the most beautiful villas and tastefully crafted apartments. Choose to rent villas in Jumeirah with 2-7 bedrooms or rent apartments in Jumeriah ranging from studios to homes with 5 bedrooms, you will be spoilt for choices. You can also find villas and apartments for sale in Jumeirah. You can also live in villa compounds here too. These are usually a common choice if you want to have access to facilities available for the community and also the gated compound safety and security. These compounds can be going in different parts of Jumeirah.

Jumeirah is ideally located on the shores of the beaches and is connected by Jumeirah road. It is just minutes away from the major attractions of the city. Commercial hubs are also located close to Jumeirah. Jumeirah is home to many entertainment destinations as well.

  • 13 mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 15 mins – Mall of Emirates
  • 16 mins – Business Bay
  • 18 mins – Dubai International Airport
  • 20 mins – Dubai Marina | JLT
  • 22 mins – Palm Jumeirah | JBR

Shopping in Jumeirah:

If you are a shopaholic, Jumeirah has many options for you to shop at. Check out Mercato Mall, Sunset Mall and Jumeirah Plaza. All these three malls house the best of brands and shops. With multiple dining options and each offering a unique shopping experience, residents of Jumeirah can enjoy an exciting life here. City Walk is home to the best in boutique shopping as well as top-notch restaurants.

Not just these, Jumeirah is very close to the largest shopping mall in the world, Dubai Mall. Just minutes from your home, you, as a resident of Jumeirah, can access this mall with ease. Dubai Mall is known not just for housing the high-end brands, but also entertainment hubs like the  Dubai Ice Rink, Sega Republic Theme Park, Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo, and the dancing Dubai Fountain.

Foodies Haven:

If you are a foodie, Jumeirah is your best bet. It is home to the best restaurants in the region. Some of the famous restaurants, like Nusret and Coya, are all a part of Jumeirah. There is a strip of drive-thru restaurants in Jumeirah, where you can find your favourite fast-food chains and cafes. The beach destination nearby, La Mer, is also home to amazing delectable restaurants and more.

Beaches:

Jumeirah itself is a waterfront development, it is on the shores of the beach all along the Jumeirah Road. As a resident of Jumeirah, you can access the Jumeirah Beach, Sunset Beach as well as Kite Beach that is close by. Another beachfront destination is La Mer, which offers a very unique beachside experience.

Hotels in Jumeirah:

Jumeirah is home to a large number of hotels as it is a common destination for tourists and offers all kinds of hotels like the Mandarin Oriental Jumeirah, Four Seasons Resort Dubai, Bulgari Resort Dubai as well as Madinat Jumeirah and Park Regis Boutique. The most iconic hotel in Dubai,  Burj Al Arab, is located in Jumeirah and is synonymous with Dubai and its skyline.

Schools in Jumeirah:

As a resident of Jumeriah, you can enrol your little kids at the Jumeira Baccalaureate School Al Shurooq Private School, or Gems Jumeirah Primary School. Other options include Horizon English School as well as Raffles International School. Older students can get admitted to the many well-reputed universities located in Dubai Knowledge Village, just minutes away from Jumeirah.

Healthcare in Jumeirah:

Residents in Jumeirah have access to Medcare Hospital as well as Emirates Hospital, Neuro Spinal Hospital, and Medcare Paediatric Specialty Centre. There are many aesthetic clinics dotted across Jumeirah that takes care of the dental, skin as well as beauty and aesthetics.

Supermarkets within Jumeirah:

Jumeirah is dotted with the best of supermarkets including Carrefour, Waitrose and Spinneys. The Village Mall, in Jumeirah 1, is also home to many cafes and supermarkets.

Leisure & Activities:

Jumeirah is a tourist destination and offers a whole range of things to do. City Walk is one of the most visited places by tourists and residents alike. It is a perfect mix of fine dining, entertainment for all ages as well as boutique shopping. If you are a fitness enthusiast, Jumeirah has got you covered with the plethora of gyms and fitness centres present within the community. There are also a host of spas for those looking to relax and chill. 

Jumeirah is a great choice if you want to live a high-end lifestyle with a lively vibe. If you are looking to buy villas & apartments in Jumeirah, it is a brilliant idea to do so. You can also rent apartments and villas in Jumeirah. Choose to live in Jumeriah and live the best life.

data.content:
Jumeirah, a waterfront community in Dubai, is known for its laid-back and luxurious lifestyle along the coast. This sought-after residential area offers a variety of properties, including private villas, townhouses, and low-rise residential buildings.

The community is well-equipped with essential facilities such as schools, nurseries, medical facilities, gyms, supermarkets, mosques, and churches. For education, there are several international schools and nurseries in the area, making it expat-friendly. Healthcare services are readily available with various hospitals and clinics nearby.

Jumeirah is also home to some of Dubai's most prominent hotels due to its beachside location. The area is perfect for those seeking a breakfront living experience close to schools, hospitals, groceries, salons, and entertainment options​​​​.

nodes.title: Four Seasons Private Residences Jumeirah
nodes.about:
Discover the epitome of luxurious living at the Four Seasons Private Residences Dubai, located along the scenic Dubai Water Canal. This prestigious development, designed by the renowned French designer Sybille de Margerie, offers a unique blend of breathtaking water views and direct access to the canal promenade. For those looking to invest, Four Seasons Private Residences Jumeirah for sale presents a rare opportunity. The complex boasts 27 elegantly furnished apartments with 2 to 4-bedroom layout, in addition to exquisite 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses, making it a sought-after destination for those searching for Four Seasons Residences Dubai for sale or considering Four Seasons Private Residences Jumeirah apartments for rent.

Residents will experience the unmatched level of service synonymous with the Four Seasons brand. The architectural design of the residences, noted for its elegant and modern features such as horizontal balconies and distinctive shading, stands as a hallmark of luxury. This development is not just a residence; it's a statement of upscale living, ideally positioned close to the Four Seasons Resort Jumeirah Beach, offering Four Seasons Private Residences Jumeirah rent options for those seeking unparalleled luxury.

As the city's most prestigious address, the standalone Four Seasons Private Residences at Jumeirah encompasses an exclusive collection of 28 residences, penthouses, and villas, all overlooking the Dubai Water Canal. Each element, from the detailed marble inlays to the hand-selected art installations in the lobby, has been thoughtfully curated to meet the expectations of those who seek nothing but the best.

nodes.title: Sur La Mer
nodes.about:
Taking inspiration from the sublime Italian architectural heritage that has transcended both time and space, Sur La Mer by Meraas is the doorway to a new dimension of luxurious seafront living in the 21st century. Situated between the blue waters of the Arabian Gulf, the beautiful Port de La Mer, and the breathtaking La Mer beachfront, this residential paradise is slated to be the first-ever freehold townhouse community located in Jumeirah 1, which is hailed as one of the region’s most sophisticated districts.

Seize the moment and indulge in European charm with a coastal appeal only at Sur La Mer in Dubai.

A Haven of Beauty Inspired by Rich Italian Architectural Heritage

Here at Sur La Mer in Jumeirah, the glory and sophistication of contemporary classic Italian architecture radiate at its finest. Each villa is distinguished by striking colour palettes and vibrant materials that emphasise genuine opulence. Featuring 3, 4, and 5-bedroom townhouses beautiful facades, and carefully planned details that appeal to your finer tastes, this is the ultimate destination where class and tranquillity give justice to a cosmopolitan lifestyle by the sea.

Add to that the awe-inspiring views of the azure sea and the skyline, the community perfectly exudes a unique and warm character that you can never get enough of.

Celebrate the Charm of European Seaside Ambience

Boasting a visually striking landscape comprising of greeneries, open spaces shaded by lemon and olive trees, and alleys beautifully covered in magenta Bougainville flowers, Sur La Mer emanates the spirit of European seaside atmosphere.

What’s more, this upscale community gives you an everyday treat through its linear park along with other world-class amenities. Hence, there is no reason why you cannot fall in love with Sur La Mer Townhouses.

Port de La Mer: Captivating Enchantress in the Heart of Dubai

Ideally situated adjacent to the mesmerising Port de La Mer, Sur La Mer is a pioneering master community strategically positioned at the tip of the peninsula. Here, residents are provided with exclusive access to a host of exceptional dining, hospitality, entertainment, and shopping experiences along with convenience and leisure options.
